title: A blaze on an Indonesian passenger ferry leaves at least 5 dead and dozens missing
description: An Indonesian ferry carrying 271 people has caught fire in waters off Madura island, killing at least five people and leaving 41 others unaccounted for, authorities said

title: Acting attorney general issues order rescinding "anti-weaponization fund"
description: The order came after Republican Senators Thom Tillis and John Cornyn threatened to block Blanche's confirmation for Attorney General if the fund was not rescinded in writing.

title: ‘Do You Think if I Had a Job I Would Have Gone?’
description: Moroccan migrants described their despair at their economic future, explaining what propelled them across the border with Spain.

title: As France’s Elders Swelter in the Heat, Postal Workers Come to the Rescue
description: To help prevent heat-related deaths, the French government has asked postal workers to check in on older people.

title: New Spider-Man film sees second-biggest ever global opening weekend
description: The strong box office performance gives a boost to Disney ahead of the much-anticipated Avengers: Doomsday.

title: Caitlin Clark breaks silence on Sophie Cunningham drama — in testy exchange with reporter

title: Preschooler nearly drowns in NJ lake — but quick-thinking bystanders, cops save her
description: The little girl was inside Newark’s Branch Brook Park on Sunday afternoon and fell into the lake near a boathouse at the southern portion of the park, the Essex County Sheriff’s Office said.

title: Jorge Polanco booed by Mets fans as woes keep worsening
description: One Met who won’t be gone by Monday’s trade deadline is Jorge Polanco, who continues to look lost at the plate.
